title: Toward Cognitive Supersensing in Multimodal Large Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2602.01541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in open-vocabulary visual understanding, yet they often struggle with cognitive visual reasoning tasks that require maintaining, transforming, and simulating abstract visual states. Existing approaches primarily scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in language, forcing inherently spatial or visual computations into discrete text tokens. We introduce Cognitive Supersensing, a training paradigm that equips MLLMs with latent visual reasoning by integrating a Latent Visual Imagery Prediction (LVIP) head that progressively learns refined visual latent states aligned with the evolving reasoning context and target answer, thereby providing a structured visual grounding signal for internal reasoning. We further introduce a reinforcement learning stage that optimizes rationale trajectories using both answer evidence and LVIP-based latent grounding, encouraging reasoning

translated_title: 面向多模态大语言模型的认知超感知
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在开放词表视觉理解方面取得了快速进展，但它们在需要维持、转换和模拟抽象视觉状态的认知视觉推理任务上常常表现不佳。现有方法主要是在语言层面扩展思维链（CoT）推理，将本质上是空间性或视觉性的计算强行压缩进离散的文本标记中。我们提出了“认知超感知”，这是一种训练范式，通过集成潜在视觉意象预测头，使多模态大语言模型具备潜在视觉推理能力。该LVIP头逐步学习与不断演化的推理上下文和目标答案相一致的精细化视觉潜在状态，从而为内部推理提供结构化的视觉锚定信号。我们进一步引入了强化学习阶段，利用答案证据和基于LVIP的潜在锚定来优化推理轨迹，鼓励推理（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出认知超感知训练范式，通过潜在视觉意象预测头与强化学习相结合，使多模态大语言模型能够在潜在空间中进行视觉推理，从而提升认知视觉推理能力，避免将视觉计算强行转化为文本标记。
en_tdlr: Proposes Cognitive Supersensing, a training paradigm that combines a Latent Visual Imagery Prediction (LVIP) head with a reinforcement learning stage to enable latent visual reasoning in multimodal large language models, avoiding the compression of spatial or visual computations into discrete text tokens.
